map.💡 公式：分贝为对数量，不能直接相加。总声压级 L = 10×log₁₀(Σ10: 💡 Formula: decibels are logarithmic quantities and cannot be added directly. Total sound pressure level L = 10×log₁₀(Σ10^(Lᵢ/10)). Adding two equal decibels increases the level by only 3 dB.

map.算出来和电表不符？: The result doesn't match the meter?
